registers.name: CONTROL
registers.description: Firmware control register for enabling command processing, clearing sticky faults, arming safe fallback, optionally bypassing output hold, and selecting a compact policy mode.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Enable command processing and command acceptance.

fields.name: CLEAR_FAULTS
fields.description: Write-one pulse to clear sticky faults and event flags.

fields.name: ARM_SAFE_FALLBACK
fields.description: Arm safe fallback operation.

fields.name: BYPASS_OUTPUT_HOLD
fields.description: Bypass output hold policy when explicitly enabled by firmware.

fields.name: MODE
fields.description: Compact operation mode selector.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Live and sticky status bits reflecting command processing, faults, and interrupt state.

fields.name: BUSY
fields.description: Control core is processing or holding a command.

fields.name: COMMAND_ACCEPTED
fields.description: Last command was accepted.

fields.name: STALE_REJECTED
fields.description: Last command was rejected as stale.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_FAULT
fields.description: Timeout or communication-loss fault active.

fields.name: INVALID_INPUT
fields.description: Velocity or policy input was invalid.

fields.name: CLAMP_APPLIED
fields.description: One or more actuator fields were clamped.

fields.name: SAFE_FALLBACK_ACTIVE
fields.description: Safe fallback output is active.

fields.name: IRQ_PENDING
fields.description: IRQ is pending and awaiting acknowledgement.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

registers.name: SEQ_IN
registers.description: Command sequence number written by firmware.

fields.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
fields.description: Command sequence number written by firmware.

registers.name: AGE_LIMIT
registers.description: Maximum accepted command age in cycles.

fields.name: MAX_AGE_CYCLES
fields.description: Maximum accepted command age in cycles.

registers.name: VELOCITY_MPS
registers.description: Fixed-point compact representation of stream velocity for the 20-55 m/s envelope.

fields.name: VELOCITY_FIXED_POINT
fields.description: Fixed-point compact representation of stream velocity for the 20-55 m/s envelope.

fields.name: PACKED_MINIMUM
fields.description: Packed per-actuator minimum limit.

fields.name: PACKED_MAXIMUM
fields.description: Packed per-actuator maximum limit.

registers.name: ACT_CMD

fields.name: PACKED_TARGET_COMMAND
fields.description: Packed actuator target command from firmware or CPU-side policy.

registers.name: LAST_GOOD

fields.name: PACKED_LAST_ACCEPTED_COMMAND
fields.description: Last accepted packed actuator command.

fields.name: CURRENT_TIMEOUT_AGE
fields.description: Current stale/timeout age counter.

fields.name: STICKY_FAULT_BITS
fields.description: Sticky fault cause bits.

registers.name: IRQ_ACK
registers.description: Write-one-to-clear interrupt and sticky event flags.

fields.name: ACKNOWLEDGE
fields.description: Write-one-to-clear interrupt and sticky event flags.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; write ignored.

sources.name: COMMAND_ACCEPTED
sources.description: Asserted when a new valid command is accepted.

sources.name: STALE_REJECTED
sources.description: Asserted when a command is rejected as stale.

sources.name: TIMEOUT_FAULT
sources.description: Asserted on timeout expiration or communication loss.

sources.name: INVALID_INPUT
sources.description: Asserted when velocity or policy input is outside the valid envelope.

sources.name: CLAMP_EVENT
sources.description: Asserted when one or more packed actuator fields are clamped.

sources.name: SAFE_FALLBACK_ENTRY
sources.description: Asserted when safe fallback is entered.

init_sequence: Reset or initialize the device and leave CONTROL.ENABLE cleared.
Program ACT_MIN and ACT_MAX with per-actuator bounds.
Program AGE_LIMIT with the maximum acceptable command age.
Program VELOCITY_MPS with the compact fixed-point velocity value.
Program SEQ_IN with the next monotonic sequence number.
Program ACT_CMD with the compact packed actuator command.
Set CONTROL.ARM_SAFE_FALLBACK as required by policy.
Set CONTROL.ENABLE to begin command processing.
polling_sequence: Read STATUS until BUSY deasserts and IRQ_PENDING is either clear or has been serviced.
Read LAST_GOOD after accepted commands to confirm the last bounded command.
Read TIMEOUT_CNT to monitor stale-age progression.
Read FAULT_CAUSE to diagnose sticky fault reasons.
If a command is rejected as stale, update SEQ_IN with a newer sequence and retry only after policy allows.
irq_sequence: On IRQ, read STATUS to determine whether the event was accepted-command, stale rejection, timeout, invalid input, clamp, or safe-fallback entry.
Write IRQ_ACK with bit 0 set to clear the interrupt and sticky event flags.
If CONTROL.CLEAR_FAULTS is required by firmware policy, write it as a one-cycle pulse in CONTROL and re-evaluate command state.
If safe fallback is active, either clear the fault under policy or program a new compact command within the allowed envelope before re-enabling acceptance.

consistency_notes: All assumptions remain compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
The register map is 32-bit aligned and directly reachable through the Wishbone/MMIO decode in the synthesizable top.
No wide streaming model transport is introduced; firmware-mediated command acceptance remains the only control-plane path.
